description: I-GODOOR, uhlelo lokusebenza olusebenza kahle lokulethwa olusebenzisa amamephu okuhlala e-Zenrin ukuphatha amaphakheji. Lolu hlelo lokusebenza lubonisa ulwazi lwephakheji njengezikhonkwane kumamephu okuhlala e-Zenrin, abonisa amagama ezakhiwo namagama epuleti, okuvumela ukuthi uqhathanise ulwazi lwephakheji nemephu yokuhlala. Isekela ukuhlela umzila wokulethwa futhi isiza ukuvimbela ukulethwa okungalungile. Isivivinyo Samahhala Sezinsuku Ezingama-30! Zonke izici ezikhokhelwayo, kufaka phakathi ukubuka imephu yokuhlala e-Zenrin, zitholakala mahhala izinsuku ezingama-30 ngemuva kokubhaliswa kokuqala okukhokhelwayo. Lokho ongakwenza nge-GODOOR: • Imephu yokuhlala yaseZenrin / Isibonisi semephu esilula ukusisebenzisa ekulethweni • Ukubhaliswa kwephakheji okulula • Ukuphathwa kwephakheji okubushelelezi • Ukuzulazula ngemoto ukuya emnyango wendawo yokulethwa • Imemo yokulethwa / Ukuphathwa kolwazi lwe-Nameplate Imisebenzi eningiliziwe ye-GODOOR: ■ Imephu yokuhlala yaseZenrin / Imephu ejwayelekile elula ukuyisebenzisela ukulethwa • Amamephu yokuhlala yaseZenrin azo zonke izindawo eJapane ayatholakala ukuze abukwe • Ibonisa amagama ezakhiwo / amapuleti namagama abaqashi • Ibonisa ulwazi lokungena kanye nemigwaqo yangasese • Umklamo wemephu ojwayelekile okwenza kube lula ukuqonda ulwazi oludingekayo ekulethweni, njengezinombolo zomgwaqo nemigwaqo ■ Ukubhaliswa kwephakheji okulula • Khetha futhi ubhalise indawo ebalazweni lendawo yokuhlala laseZenrin • Ukubhalisa ngokufunda ikheli esithombeni sesiliphu sokulethwa • Isekela ukufakwa kombhalo kanye nokufakwa ngezwi • Ingabhalisa izindawo ngisho nangaphambi kokuba kwenziwe ukufometha kwekheli ebalazweni lendawo yokuhlala laseZenrin ■ Ukuphathwa kwephakheji okubushelelezi • Inani le Amaphakheji ahlala eboniswa kumephu ejwayelekile / imephu yokuhlala yaseZenrin • Isimo sokulethwa kwephakheji sithi: Kulethiwe / Akukho / Kuphinde Kulethwe / Kuqoqwe / Kuqediwe Kuphethwe yi - Isikhathi sokulethwa/isimo sokulethwa siboniswa njengephini kumephu evamile/imephu yokuhlala yaseZenrin - Isimo kanye nezinguquko zesikhathi sokulethwa kwesikhala sokulethwa esiqediwe/singekho/ukulethwa kabusha ziphathwa kalula - Bonisa noma yiliphi iphakheji oyifunayo kumephu evamile/imephu yokuhlala yaseZenrin usebenzisa umsebenzi wokuhlunga iphakheji - Ukubhaliswa kokuthi ukulethwa endaweni ethile noma ebhokisini lokulethwa kungenzeka - Ukubuka ulwazi lwephakheji kanye nemephu yokuhlala yaseZenrin ngokungenamthungo ■ Ukuzulazula ngemoto ukuya endaweni yokulethwa - Qalisa ukuzulazula ngemoto ngokuthepha okukodwa kusuka kulwazi lwephakheji - Zula umzila wemoto uye endaweni yokulethwa - Isebenzisa ukuzulazula kwemoto okuseqophelweni eliphezulu kusetshenziswa amamephu aseZenrin ■ Ukuphathwa kolwazi lwememo/ipuleti lokulethwa - Amanothi aphathelene nendawo yokulethwa angabhaliswa njenge-"Memo Yokulethwa" - Ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana namapuleti egama luphathwa esigabeni "sepuleti legama" - Amanothi Okulethwa namapuleti egama angabukwa noma nini ngesikhathi esilandelayo ukulethwa. Kunconyelwe: ■ Abashayeli bokulethwa kwempahla elula ■ Abashayeli bezithuthuthu ■ Abashayeli bokulethwa kokudla, ukuthutha, kanye nokulethwa ■ Labo abasebenzisa amamephu okuhlala eZenrin emsebenzini wokulethwa Kulula kulezi zimo: ■ Ufuna ukwenza amamephu okuhlala eZenrin abe yidijithali ■ Ufuna ukuphatha ulwazi lwephakheji kumamephu okuhlala eZenrin ■ Ufuna ukugwema inkinga yokufaka amakheli okulethwa ezinhlelweni zokuzulazula kwezimoto ■ Amamephu okuhlala kunzima ukuwabona ebumnyameni ngesikhathi sokulethwa ebusuku ■ Ufuna ithuluzi elingasetshenziswa kalula ngesandla esisodwa ngisho nangesikhathi sokulethwa Mayelana namaMephu okuHlala eZenrin: Amamephu okuhlala eZenrin ahlinzeka ngolwazi oluphelele lwesifunda kanye nolwezindlu komasipala abangu-1,741 kulo lonke elaseJapan, ngokusekelwe ocwaningweni olusendaweni olwenziwe ngabasebenzi abakhethekile. Ukubuyekezwa kwenziwa njalo, minyaka yonke ezindaweni zasemadolobheni kanye njalo eminyakeni engu-2-5 kwezinye izindawo. Amamephu okuhlala eZenrin ahlala eletha idatha yakamuva. Amamephu okuhlala eZenrin asetshenziswa amakhasimende ahlukahlukene njengengqalasizinda esekela amabhizinisi afana nokulethwa, ukusatshalaliswa, kanye nokuthengiswa kwendlu ngendlu. Mayelana neMephu Yokuhlala yeZenrin/Ukubuyekezwa Kwemephu Ejwayelekile Womabili amamephu ajwayelekile kanye namamephu okuhlala eZenrin abuyekezwa ngolwazi lwakamuva ngokushesha nje lapho iZenrin ibuyekeza idatha yemephu. Ukuze uthole imibuzo mayelana nolwazi lwemephu, sicela uxhumane (nesevisi yamakhasimende eZenrin). I-OS Esekelwayo Enconyiwe: 9 noma ngaphezulu Mayelana Nokusebenzisa Izici Ezikhokhelwayo: ・Isebenzisa umsebenzi wokubhalisa we-Google Play. ・Ukuze umise izibuyekezo ezizenzakalelayo, sicela uye kuzilungiselelo ze-Google Play -> "Okubhaliselwe". ■Amanothi ・Sicela ubhalise i-akhawunti eyodwa ngomsebenzisi ngamunye ngokuhambisana nemigomo yesevisi. Asikwazi ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kahle uma abantu abaningi babelana nge-akhawunti. ・Lolu hlelo lokusebenza ludinga uxhumano lwe-inthanethi nge-3G/4G/5G noma i-Wi-Fi. ・Sicela usebenzise ngokuphephile ngokulandela imithetho yomgwaqo kanye nezinyathelo zokuqapha ukusetshenziswa. Ukusebenzisa ifoni ephathekayo (kufaka phakathi ukuyibuka; okufanayo kuyasebenza lapha) ngenkathi ushayela imoto, isithuthuthu, ibhayisikili, njll., kuyingozi kakhulu. Uma udinga ukusebenzisa ifoni ephathekayo, sicela umgibeli ayisebenzise noma ayimise imoto endaweni ephephile. * Sicela uqaphele ukuthi ukubuka ifoni ephathekayo ngenkathi ushayela kungase kwephule imithetho yomgwaqo. Ngeke sithwale icala nganoma yiziphi izingozi noma izehlakalo ezenzeka ngenkathi usebenzisa ifoni yakho ephathekayo.
summary: I-GODOOR, uhlelo lokusebenza lokulethwa nokudiliva abashayeli oluhlanganisa amamephu okuhlala e-Zenrin, ukuzulazula kwemoto, nokuphathwa kwemithwalo, lusekela imisebenzi yokulethwa okusheshayo.
